title: 300 unbleached parchment rounds
text: 300 unbleached parchment rounds. I purchased a 5" press and then purchased 4" parchment rounds - no good! So I purchased these, a perfect fit.  Place the parchment round in the bottom, one on top and press.  Ready for the freezer or the grill.  Makes the press meat fall right out!
